items.title: Complete current release assurance evidence
items.complexityRationale: Requires a second qualified reviewer, signing key custody, independent signed review, distribution monitoring, and final production verification.
items.scope: release evidence, hosted CI, signing, SBOM, provenance, independent review, and release verification
implementationSteps: Add a distinct qualified collaborator or team and require at least one approving review for main.
Provision a controlled release-signing identity and externally trusted public-key fingerprint.
Establish distribution monitoring, failure ownership, and artifact revocation signals.
Obtain a distinct independently signed review bound to the exact candidate.
Sign the candidate checksum manifest and run production verification.
Clear blockers only after all evidence validates.
acceptanceCriteria: Current-revision matrix, CodeQL, and hosted secret/dependency controls pass.
SBOM, provenance, and trusted signature verify.
A distinct independent review binds the exact candidate.
Distribution monitoring and revocation ownership are recorded.
Production release verification has no blockers.
items.rollout: Clear evidence blockers independently; publish only after all are complete.
items.rollback: Reinstate blockers and revoke affected artifacts if evidence becomes invalid.
items.approvalReason: Requires external CI, signing key custody, independent review, and possible publication.
items.residualRisk: Release assurance expires as code, dependencies, platforms, and keys change.

limitations: AUD-0201, AUD-0202, AUD-0203, AUD-0204, AUD-0206, and AUD-0207 were closed by re-audit and are not scheduled again.
This plan does not execute remediation.
External and destructive actions remain separately approval-gated.
P3 specialist assurance and P4 source, candidate-integrity, hosted CI, CodeQL, and repository-hardening work are complete.
P1 and P2-execution-safety records predate immutable snapshots and remain historical evidence; new executions use schema 3.0 snapshots.
